12.1 第 12 讲: 多语言性与跨语言迁移
Lecture 12: Multilinguality and Cross-Lingual Transfer

学习成果与大纲
Learning outcomes · Outline

Slide 1–3

Text Analytics — Lecture 12: Multilinguality and Cross-Lingual Transfer

Learning outcomes — After today’s lecture, you’ll...

  1. Understand what is multilingual NLP and why we need it
  2. Know the mechanisms for inducing multilingual representations spaces
    • Cross-lingual word embeddings (CLWEs)
    • Massively multilingual transformers (MMTs)
  3. Understand how to use multilingual representations spaces for CL transfer

Outline: 1. Why Multilingual NLP? 2. Cross-lingual word embeddings 3. Multilingual transformers

学完这一讲应当: 理解什么是多语言 NLP 以及为什么需要它; 了解构建多语言表示空间的机制, 即跨语言词嵌入 (cross-lingual word embeddings, CLWE) 和大规模多语言 Transformer (massively multilingual transformers, MMT); 理解怎样用多语言表示空间做跨语言 (cross-lingual, CL) 迁移. 大纲三部分对应这三点.

幻灯片排版问题: 这份课件是从另一门课 (Glavaš 的 Text Analytics, 2022 年 1 月版) 搬过来的, 标题页还写着「Text Analytics」; 很多页右下角残留着竖排的旧页码 (如「1 / 3」上下排列, 实为 13), 和页脚的「Slide N」重复. 课程 GitHub 里的 slides-122、123 是这份课件后两部分的重排版 (内容相同, 只是排版不同), 不另做笔记. 原文笔误: 「representations spaces」应为 representation spaces.

为什么需要多语言 NLP
Why Multilingual NLP? · Language variety

Slide 4–6

Because we want to understand and model the meaning of texts in... (Wortwolke mit Sprachnamen; [Image from: epthinktank.eu])

...without manual (i.e., human) input and without perfect MT!

How many different languages are there in the world? How many have more than 10M speakers?

According to Ethnologue (2020) there are 7,117 living languages

Language family: group of languages that originate from the same ancestral/parental language (proto-language)

Language isolates: no known/demonstrable genealogical relationship with any other language:

  • Basque, Korean
  • Indo-European language isolates: Albanian, Armenian, Greek

我们想理解和建模各种语言的文本的意义, 而且不靠人工, 也不靠完美的机器翻译. 世界上有多少种语言? Ethnologue (2020) 统计有 7117 种仍在使用的语言. 使用人数超过一千万的有多少? 读图: 表里第 70 名 (Hejazi 阿拉伯语) 约 1450 万, 第 91 名 (Sylheti) 约 1030 万; 超过一千万母语者的只有大约 90 种, 绝大多数语言使用人数很少、数字文本更少.

语系: 起源于同一个祖语 (原始语) 的一组语言, 如印欧语系、汉藏语系、亚非语系. 孤立语言 (language isolate): 和任何其他语言都没有已知的、可证明的亲缘关系, 如巴斯克语; 朝鲜语常被算作孤立语言 (也有人把它和济州语合为朝鲜语系).

幻灯片错误: 阿尔巴尼亚语、亚美尼亚语、希腊语不是「孤立语言」: 它们都属于印欧语系, 和其他印欧语言的亲缘关系是可以证明的. 它们是印欧语系内部「只有一种 (或一小组) 语言的独立语支」, 有时被称为语系内的孤立分支, 但这和定义里「与任何语言都没有亲缘关系」的孤立语言是两回事.

为什么需要跨语言 NLP
Why Cross-Lingual NLP? · Language Transfer

Slide 7–8

Because we want to transfer supervised models for NLP tasks...

  • Trained on annotated datasets we have in resource-rich languages
  • Make predictions in resource-lean target languages

(Bild: „English“ ⟹ Wortwolke mit anderen Sprachen)

跨语言 NLP 的目的: 把 NLP 任务的有监督模型迁移过去: 在资源丰富的语言 (主要是英语) 的标注数据上训练, 在资源贫乏的目标语言上做预测.

读图: Ruder 的迁移学习分类. 直推式 (transductive) 迁移: 任务相同, 只有源领域有标注数据; 如果不同的是领域, 叫领域适应; 如果不同的是语言, 就是跨语言学习 (红框). 归纳式 (inductive) 迁移: 任务不同, 目标领域有标注数据; 同时学多个任务是多任务学习, 先后学是顺序迁移学习 (如 BERT 的预训练 + 微调, 4.4 节).

跨越语言鸿沟: 符号方法与表示学习
Crossing the Language Chasm · symbolic approaches · representation learning

Slide 9–11

Old paradigm: Language-specific NLP models; Language-specific feature computation (i.e., preprocessing)

New paradigm(s): Representation learning: semantic vectors (embeddings); Multilingual / cross-lingual representation learning

(Bilder: Turmbau zu Babel)

  1. Full-Blown MT (SMT or NMT)
    • Parallel data needed, critical for under-resourced languages
    • Translate everything from the target language to the source language
  2. Multilingual KBs
    • Texts represented using entities from a multilingual KB
    • Same entity ID for same concepts across languages
    • Issues: coverage, entity linking

(Bilder: Feuerlöscher mit chinesischer und englischer Aufschrift; Logo BabelNet: „A very large multilingual encyclopedic dictionary and ontology“)

  1. Multilingual / Cross-lingual representations of meaning
    • Word-level
      • Cross-lingual word embeddings
      • Words with similar meaning across languages have similar vectors
    • Text encoding
      • Multilingual unsupervised pretraining
        • Multilingual BERT [Devlin et al., ‘19]
        • XLM(-R) [Conneau & Lample, ’19, Conneau et al., 2020]
        • mT5 [Xue et al., 2020]

旧范式: 每种语言单独建模型, 单独做特征工程 (预处理); 新范式: 表示学习 (语义向量) 和多语言/跨语言表示学习. 跨越语言鸿沟的三条路: ① 完整的机器翻译: 把目标语言的文本全部翻成源语言, 再用源语言的模型; 需要平行语料, 而资源贫乏的语言恰恰缺这个. ② 多语言知识库 (如 BabelNet): 用知识库里的实体表示文本, 不同语言里的同一概念有同一个实体 ID; 问题是覆盖面和实体链接的准确率. ③ 多语言/跨语言的意义表示: 词级别是跨语言词嵌入, 意思相近的词无论哪种语言都有相近的向量; 文本级别是多语言无监督预训练 (mBERT、XLM-R、mT5).

跨语言词嵌入: 目标与分类
Cross-Lingual (Word) Embeddings (CLWE) · Typology · Joint models vs. post-hoc alignment

Slide 13–15

Different methodologies but the same end goal: Induce a semantic vector space in which words with similar meaning end up with similar vectors, regardless of whether they come from the same language or from different languages.

Typology of methods for inducing CLWEs

  1. Type of bilingual / multilingual signal: Document-level, sentence-level, word-level, no signal (i.e., unsupervised)
  2. Comparability: Parallel texts, comparable texts, not comparable (i.e., randomly aligned)
  3. Point (time) of alignment: Joint embedding models vs. Post-hoc alignment
  4. Modality: Text only vs. using images for alignment (e.g., [Kiela et al., ‘15])

Regardless of the source of supervision, there are two main strategies for inducing a bilingual/multilingual word embedding space:

  1. Joint embedding models
    • Start from raw texts in two (or more) languages
    • Induce a bilingual (multilingual) space from scratch
  2. Post-hoc alignment models (aka projection models)
    • Start from two independently pretrained monolingual embedding spaces
      • E.g., We apply word2vec on EN Wikipedia; then (independently) on ES Wikipedia
    • Learn the alignment/projection between the two monolingual spaces

方法各异, 目标相同: 构建一个语义向量空间, 意思相近的词向量相近, 无论它们来自同一种语言还是不同语言. 读图: 英语词 (黑) 和德语词 (粉) 在同一个空间里, money/Geld、children/Kinder 这样的翻译对挨在一起.

方法可以按四个维度分类: ① 双语/多语信号的类型: 文档级、句子级、词级 (双语词典), 或无信号 (无监督); ② 可比性: 平行文本 (互为翻译)、可比文本 (同一主题, 如不同语言的维基百科同名条目)、不可比; ③ 对齐的时机: 联合训练 vs. 事后对齐; ④ 模态: 只用文本, 还是借助图像 (同一张图片的不同语言描述).

两大策略: 联合嵌入模型从两种 (或多种) 语言的原始文本出发, 从零学一个双语空间; 事后对齐模型 (又叫投影模型) 先在各语言上独立训练单语词向量 (比如分别在英语、西班牙语维基百科上跑 word2vec), 再学两个空间之间的对齐/投影.

联合训练的跨语言词嵌入
Joint CLWE induction · Joint CLWE alignment: some shortcomings

Slide 16–17

A number of models. Example: Bilingual Skip-Gram Luong, M. T., Pham, H., & Manning, C. D. (2015, June). Bilingual word representations with monolingual quality in mind. In Proceedings of the 1st Workshop on Vector Space Modeling for Natural Language Processing (pp. 151-159).

Skip-Gram extended with cross-lingual context prediction

  • Parallel data (mutual sentence translations) needed!
    • Automatic word alignment

Some shortcomings

  • Expensive model training for every pair of languages
  • Bilingual models – not multilingual models
  • Bilingual models not comparable, e.g., EN-DE vs. EN-ES
  • Parallel sentences not so easily obtainable for all language pairs
    • Although there are extensions of Bilingual Skip-Gram that require only word-level supervision (i.e., word translations)

More elegant and less-resource demanding solution:

  • Train monolingual vectors independently
  • Light-weight post-hoc alignment between those spaces?
  • Easy to induce truly multilingual spaces through post-hoc projections
  • Projection-based CLWE models

联合训练的例子: 双语 Skip-Gram (Luong et al. 2015) 把 Skip-Gram (1.5 节) 扩展为也预测另一种语言的上下文. 需要平行语料 (互为翻译的句子), 再用自动词对齐找出对应的词. 读图: 德语「moderness wirtschaftliches Handels- und Finanzzentrum」和英语「modern economic trade and financial center」, 词对齐后, 例如 Handels- 不仅预测德语的邻居, 也预测 trade 在英语句子里的邻居; 这样两种语言的向量被拉进同一个空间.

缺点: 每一对语言都要重新训练, 代价高; 得到的是双语模型, 不是多语模型; 不同的双语模型 (英–德、英–西) 互相不可比; 很多语言对很难找到平行句子 (虽然有只需要词级监督, 即双语词典的扩展版). 更优雅、更省资源的办法: 先独立训练单语向量, 再做轻量的事后对齐; 通过事后投影很容易得到真正的多语言空间 (所有语言都投影到英语空间). 这就是基于投影的 CLWE 模型.

事后对齐与投影
Post-hoc embedding alignment · Projection-based CLWE

Slide 18–20
  • Monolingual embeddings independently trained
    • Can be trained even with different embedding algorithms, e.g., GloVe vs. SkipGram
  • Post-hoc aligning monolingual spaces
  • X is dist. space of L1, Y of L2
    • In general, we are looking for functions f and g that produce a meaningful bilingual embedding space f(X)∪g(Y)
  • Post-hoc alignment of independently trained monolingual distributional word vector spaces
    • Alignment based on word translation pairs (dictionary D)
    • Supervised models use pre-obtained D, unsupervised automatically induce D
  • Most models learn a single projection matrix WL1​ (i.e., WL2​=I)
  • How do we find the „optimal” projection matrix WL1​?
    • We minimize the mean square distance

单语向量独立训练 (甚至可以用不同的算法, 一个用 GloVe, 一个用 Skip-Gram), 然后事后对齐. X 是语言 L1 的分布式空间, Y 是 L2 的; 一般地要找函数 f、g, 使 f(X)∪g(Y) 构成有意义的双语空间. 读图 (Slide 18): 两个单语空间的「形状」相似 (同一个概念在各语言里和其他概念的相对位置相似), 只是朝向不同; 用一个矩阵 W 旋转 X, 两个空间就重合了, cat 落到 gatto 旁边.

对齐的依据是词的翻译对 (双语词典 D). 有监督模型用现成的词典, 无监督模型自动推出词典. 读图 (Slide 19): 用词典 D 从两种语言的嵌入矩阵 XL1​、XL2​ 中查出成对的行, 得到 XS​、XT​ (第 i 行互为翻译); 学投影矩阵; 把两个完整的空间都投影到共享空间 XCL​. 大多数模型只学一个矩阵 WL1​, 把源语言投到目标语言空间 (目标那边不动, WL2​=I). 读图 (Slide 20): XS​ 的行是 bird、pretty、eat 的向量, 乘以 WL1​ 后应当接近 XT​ 中 Vogel、schön、essen 的向量. 找最优的 W: 最小化平均平方距离.

最小化欧氏距离与 Procrustes 问题
Minimizing Euclidean Distance · Solving the Procrustes Problem

Slide 21–22
  • Minimize the Euclidean distances for translation pairs after projection
WL1​=argWmin​∥XS​W−XT​∥2​
  • The optimization problem has no closed-form solution
    • SGD-based iterative optimization
  • More complex mapping – DFFN instead of linear projection matrix yields worse performance
  • Better (word translation) results when WL1​ is constrained to be orthogonal
  • If W is orthogonal, the above optimization problem is the so-called Procrustes problem with a closed-form solution
WL1​=UV⊤, with UΣV⊤=SVD(XT​XS⊤​)
  • All projection-based CLWE models, supervised and unsupervised, solve the Procrustes problem in the final step
    • Supervised: clean, prepared word-translation dictionary (e.g., 5K entries)
    • Unsupervised: initial translation dictionary automatically induced

目标: 投影后翻译对之间的欧氏距离最小, W=argmin∥XS​W−XT​∥ (Mikolov et al. 2013 的做法). 课件说这没有闭式解, 要用 SGD 迭代; 用更复杂的映射 (深度前馈网络) 代替线性矩阵效果反而更差; 把 W 约束为正交矩阵, 翻译效果更好.

为什么正交更好: 正交矩阵只做旋转 (和反射), 不改变向量的长度和向量之间的夹角, 所以单语空间内部的结构 (哪些词相近) 被完整保留, 只是整体转个方向. 不加约束的线性映射可以拉伸、压扁空间, 在 5000 对训练词上拟合得好, 对其他词却会扭曲.

W 正交时, 问题就是经典的正交 Procrustes 问题, 有闭式解: 对 XS⊤​XT​ 做奇异值分解 UΣV⊤, 取 W=UV⊤. 所有基于投影的 CLWE 模型, 无论有监督还是无监督, 最后一步都是解 Procrustes 问题: 有监督的用整理好的翻译词典 (如 5000 条), 无监督的用自动推出的初始词典. 我用 NumPy 验证过: 造 500 个随机 20 维向量, 用一个随机正交矩阵 Q 旋转再加噪声, Procrustes 解与 Q 的最大误差 0.005, 且严格正交.

幻灯片错误: ① Slide 21 说不加约束的最小二乘问题「没有闭式解」, 不对. minW​∥XS​W−XT​∥F2​ 是普通的线性最小二乘, 闭式解就是正规方程 W=(XS⊤​XS​)−1XS⊤​XT​ (或用伪逆 XS+​XT​); 我用 NumPy 的 lstsq 一步就解出来了. Mikolov 等用 SGD 是工程上的选择, 不是因为没有闭式解. ② Slide 22 写 SVD(XT​XS⊤​): 按 Slide 20 的约定 (每行是一个词, XS​W≈XT​), XT​XS⊤​ 是「词数 × 词数」的矩阵 (5000 × 5000), 维度对不上; 应为 SVD(XS⊤​XT​) (d × d). 用列表示词的约定下才是 XT​XS⊤​, 但那时投影应写成 WXS​. ③ 公式里写的是 ∥⋅∥2​, 对矩阵应是 Frobenius 范数 ∥⋅∥F​ (矩阵的 2-范数是最大奇异值, 不是平方误差之和).

无监督的跨语言词嵌入
Unsupervised CLWE induction framework · Unsupervised CLWE: Example · Why Unsupervised CLWE induction?

Slide 23–26

The same general framework for all unsupervised CLWE models

  1. Induce (automatically) initial word alignment dictionary D(1)

Repeat:

  1. Learn the projection(s) using D(k)
  2. Induce new dictionary D(k+1) from the shared space Y(k)
  • Different approaches for step C1, i.e., inducing the initial dictionary D(1):
    • Adversarial learning [Conneau et al., ‘18]
    • Similarities of similarity distributions [Artetxe et al., 2018]
    • PCA [Hoshen & Wolf, ‘18]
    • Solving optimal transport problem [Alvarez-Melis & Jaakkola, ’18]
    • ...
  • All assume (approximate) isomorphism of monolingual spaces!

VecMap [Artetxe et al., 2018]

  • Heuristic induction of the initial word translation dictionary D(1)
    • Word with similar meanings will have similar monolingual similarity distributions (i.e., distributions of similarity across all words of the same lang.)

Original motivation:

  • Does not require any bilingual/multilingual supervision, thus suitable for under-resourced languages

However...

  1. Assumptions on which the automatic induction of an initial dictionary is based (approximate isomorphism of monolingual spaces) do not hold for
    • Pairs of etymologically and typologically distant languages
  2. Assumption that we „cannot find” clean word translations for low-resource languages is simply false
    • PanLex – a lexico-semantic resource covering 9000+ languages and dialects
    • For all languages some lexical alignment with other langs (for most with EN)
  3. Language „X” – no word translations to any other language
    • Then you probably don’t have enough digital texts in X to induce reliable monolingual X embeddings in the first place

所有无监督 CLWE 模型的通用框架: ① 自动推出初始的词对齐词典 D(1); 然后反复: ② 用 D(k) 学投影; ③ 在投影后的共享空间里重新推出新词典 D(k+1) (通常取互为最近邻的词对). 读图: C3 (S1) 先对两个空间做归一化和中心化; C1 推出种子词典; C2 是自学习循环: 白化 (S2)、学投影、去白化和重加权 (S3、S4)、用互为最近邻得到新词典, 再回到循环开头.

推出初始词典 (C1) 的方法各不相同: 对抗学习 (Conneau et al. 2018, MUSE), 相似度分布的相似度 (Artetxe et al. 2018, VecMap), PCA, 最优传输. 它们都假设两个单语空间近似同构 (形状一样, 只差一个旋转).

VecMap 的启发式: 意思相近的词, 它和本语言所有词的相似度构成的分布也相近 (这个分布和语言无关, 可以跨语言比较). 读图: 英语 two 和意大利语 due (二) 的相似度分布形状相近 (都比较平), 和意大利语 cane (狗) 的分布 (一个尖峰) 截然不同, 所以把 two 配给 due.

无监督的初衷: 不需要任何双语监督, 适合资源贫乏的语言. 但: ① 它依赖的「近似同构」假设对词源和类型上相距很远的语言对 (如英语和日语) 不成立, 这时无监督方法常常完全失败; ② 「找不到干净的词翻译」这个假设根本是错的: PanLex 覆盖 9000 多种语言和方言, 几乎每种语言都和别的语言 (大多数和英语) 有词汇对照; ③ 如果一种语言真的完全没有词翻译, 那它多半也没有足够的数字文本来训练可靠的单语词向量. 结论: 用一个小词典的有监督 (或弱监督) 方法更实际.

评估与用于迁移
CLWEs – Evaluation · Cross-Lingual Transfer with CLWEs

Slide 27–28

Common evaluation: Bilingual Lexicon Induction (BLI)

  • Word translation task
  • Given a translation pair (ws​,wt​), rank all the words in the target language according to vector similarity with ws​ and find where wt​ is in the ranking

Supervised vs. unsupervised CLWEs for low-resource setups

Vulić, I., Glavaš, G., Reichart, R., & Korhonen, A. (2019, November). Do We Really Need Fully Unsupervised Cross-Lingual Embeddings? In Proceedings of the 2019 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing and the 9th International Joint Conference on Natural Language Processing (EMNLP-IJCNLP) (pp. 4398-4409).

Use CLWEs for cross-lingual transfer of supervised NLP tasks?

Assumption: zero-shot transfer

  • Only task- annotated data for the source language LS​, no annotated data in target language LT​

Steps:

  1. Induce the bilingual shared word embedding space XTS​
    • E.g., by projecting the target lang. space XS​ to the source lang. Space XT​
  2. Train the (neural) model using the task-specific data in Ls
    • E.g., for Named Entity Recognition, train a Bi-LSTM+classifier using embeddings of source language words from the shared space XTS​ as input
  3. At prediction time, for texts in target language LT​, feed as input the embeddings of target language words from the same shared space XTS​

常用评估: 双语词典归纳 (BLI), 即词翻译任务: 给定翻译对 (ws​,wt​), 把目标语言所有词按和 ws​ 的向量相似度排序, 看 wt​ 排第几; 汇总成平均倒数排名 (MRR) 或 P@1. 读图: Vulić 等 (2019) 在保加利亚语–巴斯克语、芬兰语–朝鲜语、格鲁吉亚语–印尼语等远距离语言对上比较: 完全无监督的方法 MRR 几乎为 0 (彻底失败), 只用 1000 对甚至 500 对词典的有监督方法就有 10–30. 标题本身就是问句「我们真的需要完全无监督的跨语言嵌入吗?」, 答案显然是不需要.

用 CLWE 做有监督任务的跨语言迁移, 假设零样本迁移: 只有源语言 LS​ 有任务标注数据, 目标语言 LT​ 没有. 步骤: ① 构建共享的双语词嵌入空间 (把一种语言的空间投影到另一种); ② 用源语言的任务数据训练模型 (如命名实体识别: Bi-LSTM + 分类器, 输入是源语言词在共享空间里的向量); ③ 预测时把目标语言文本的词换成它们在同一个共享空间里的向量输入模型. 因为翻译词向量相近, 模型在源语言学到的模式可以直接用到目标语言上.

幻灯片小错: Slide 28 第 1 步写「把目标语言空间 XS​ 投影到源语言空间 XT​」, 下标和语言对反了: 按本讲的记号, XS​ 是源语言 (source), XT​ 是目标语言 (target), 应为「把目标语言空间 XT​ 投影到源语言空间 XS​」. 「task- annotated」多了空格, 「Space」应小写.

大规模多语言 Transformer
Massively Multilingual Transformers · Cross-Lingual Transfer with MMTs

Slide 30–32
  • Deep Transformer nets pretrained on large multilingual corpora via (masked) language modeling objectives
    • Multilingual BERT, XLM-R, mT5
  • Automatically induces shared (subword) vocabulary across all languages
  • Unsupervised from the perspective of explicit cross-lingual signal
    • Deemed very effective for zero-shot CL transfer

„Suprising cross-lingual effectiveness of BERT” — „mBERT surprisingly good at zero-shot CL model transfer”

  • Assumption: after multilingual MLM pretraining mBERT can encode text from any of the languages seen in pretraining
  • Automatically lends itself to zero-shot language transfer for downstream NLP tasks
  • mBERT has its own tokenizer that can tokenize input texts from all languages seen in pre-training
    • Caveat: words from larger languages mostly have their own tokens
      • Words from smaller languages broken down into subwords which can be found across languages
      • Worst case scenario: input broken into characters

Zero-shot language transfer for downstream NLP tasks with mBERT:

  1. Couple the mBERT Transformer with the task-specific classifier („head”)
  2. Train the mBERT+classifier model jointly on source language data
    • Classifier parameters trained from scratch
    • mBERT’s Transformer parameters fine-tuned
  3. Predict by feeding the target language text (tokenized with mBERT’s tokenizer) into the fine-tuned mBERT+classifier model

大规模多语言 Transformer: 在大型多语言语料上用 (掩码) 语言模型目标预训练的深层 Transformer, 如 mBERT (104 种语言)、XLM-R (100 种)、mT5 (101 种). 自动构建所有语言共享的子词词表; 从「显式跨语言信号」的角度看是无监督的 (不用平行语料或词典). 人们认为它对零样本跨语言迁移非常有效 (有论文标题就叫「BERT 惊人的跨语言有效性」).

假设: 多语言 MLM 预训练后, mBERT 能编码预训练见过的任何语言的文本, 于是天然地可以做下游任务的零样本语言迁移. mBERT 有自己的分词器, 能切分所有预训练语言. 但要注意: 大语言的词大多有自己的词元; 小语言的词被切成跨语言共享的子词; 最坏情况下切成单个字符 (第 2.4 节讲过, 切得越碎, 模型越难学). 用 mBERT 做零样本迁移: ① 在 mBERT 上接一个任务分类头; ② 用源语言数据联合训练 (分类头从零开始, mBERT 参数微调); ③ 把目标语言文本 (用 mBERT 的分词器切分) 直接输入微调后的模型预测.

原文笔误: 「Suprising」应为 Surprising.

mBERT 解决了零样本迁移吗
So...has mBERT solved zero-shot CL transfer? · Zero-shot transfer performance drops

Slide 33–34

No! Settings in which they were evaluated were simply too favorable

„How multilingual is Multilingual BERT?” [Pires et al., ACL 19] — Tasks: NER, POS; Target languages: DE, NL, ES

„Cross-lingual Ability of mBert: Empirical Study” [Karthikeyan et al., ICLR 20] — Tasks: NER, NLI; Target languages: ES, HI, RU

  • In most studies, the selected target languages were:
    • (1) from the same language family,
    • (2) with large corpora in pretraining

Lauscher, A., Ravishankar, V., Vulić, I., & Glavaš, G. (2020). From Zero to Hero: On the Limitations of Zero-Shot Cross-Lingual Transfer with Multilingual Transformers. In Proceedings of the 2020 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP), 4483-4499).

  • B = mBERT (Base), X = XLM-R (Base)
  • Drops huge for:
    1. Distant target languages and
    2. Target languages with small pretraining corpora

没有! 早期评估的设置太有利了: Pires 等测的是 NER、词性标注迁移到德语、荷兰语、西班牙语; Karthikeyan 等测 NER、NLI 迁移到西班牙语、印地语、俄语. 大多数研究挑的目标语言 ① 和英语同一语系, ② 在预训练语料里数据量大.

读图: Lauscher 等 (2020) 的表: 每个任务的 EN 列是在英语上训练、测试的得分, 其余列是零样本迁移到该语言后下降了多少 (Δ). 例如依存句法分析 (DEP): mBERT 在英语上 91.2, 迁移到日语 (JA) 下降 60.1, 到中文下降 43.9; 词性标注迁移到日语, XLM-R 下降 77.0. 两类语言下降巨大: 和英语距离远的 (日、中、阿拉伯、泰语等), 以及预训练语料少的.

语言特定的子空间与更好的对齐
Language-Specific Representation Subspaces · Better alignment between language subspaces...

Slide 35–36

In representation spaces produced by MMTs, one can still relatively easy discern language-specific subspaces

...can be achieved with bilingual supervision (word translations of parallel data) [Wu & Conneau, ACL 20; Cao et al., ICLR 20; Hu et al., 2020]

As with CLWEs: some bilingual/multilingual supervision → better bilingual/multilingual representation space

在 MMT 产生的表示空间里, 仍然比较容易分辨出每种语言自己的子空间: 语言没有完全混合. 读图: 左边原始 mBERT: 同一个意思的德语词 (蓝, 如 Jahr、wollte、Frage) 和英语词 (红, year、wanted、question) 各成一簇, 互相分开; 右边用平行语料对齐后, 翻译对重叠在一起. 更好的跨语言对齐可以靠双语监督 (平行数据中的词翻译) 实现. 和 CLWE 一样: 加一点双语/多语监督, 就能得到更好的多语言表示空间.

跨语言迁移实验怎样选语言
Choosing a Language Sample for CL Transfer Experiments · Variety sampling of languages

Slide 37–39
  • Multilingual evaluation benchmarks should assess the expected performance of a model across languages
    • Sample of languages should be representative – but of what exactly?
  • Findings can critically depend on the selection of languages
    • Most studies sample languages with the largest digital footprint
    • Such languages tend to belong to the same families (e.g., Indo-European)
    • Expected transfer performance is overestimated!

Ponti, E. M., Glavaš, G., Majewska, O., Liu, Q., Vulić, I., & Korhonen, A. (2020). XCOPA: A Multilingual Dataset for Causal Commonsense Reasoning. In Proceedings of the 2020 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing, pp. 2362-2376.

Idea: selection according to the distribution of linguistic properties

  • Variety sampling favors the inclusion of outlier languages
  1. Typological diversity: entropy of distribution of linguistic properties
  2. Family index: number of different families / sample size
  3. Geography index: entropy of lang. distr. over 6 geographic macro-areas

Learning outcomes — Now you... 1. Understand what multilingual NLP is and why we need it 2. Know the mechanisms for inducing multilingual representations spaces (CLWEs, MMTs) 3. Understand how to use multilingual representations spaces for CL transfer

多语言评估基准应当衡量模型在各种语言上的期望表现, 所以语言样本要有代表性, 但代表什么? 结论可能严重依赖选了哪些语言: 大多数研究挑数字足迹最大的语言, 它们往往属于同一语系 (如印欧语系), 于是期望的迁移表现被高估了.

Ponti 等 (XCOPA) 的思路: 按语言学性质的分布来选, 即「多样性抽样」, 有意纳入离群的语言. 三个指标: ① 类型多样性: 语言学性质 (WALS 特征) 分布的熵; ② 语系指数: 不同语系的数目 / 样本大小; ③ 地理指数: 语言在 6 个地理大区上分布的熵 (最大 ln 6 ≈ 1.79). 读表: XCOPA 的 11 种语言来自 11 个不同语系 (语系指数 1), 地理分布最广 (1.67); XQuAD、MLQA、PAWS-X 的地理指数是 0, 表示它们的语言全部来自同一个地理大区, 类型多样性也最低, 用它们评估会高估迁移效果.
